nom: Cetaphil Healthy Renew Purified Peptides Night Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or very dry skin describe the cream as rich, moisturizing, and effective at reducing flakiness, with some calling it a holy-grail for dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with eczema, rosacea, or reactive skin, generally report good tolerance, soothing effects, and no irritation, though a few dislike the scent.
segments.mature: Older or mature-skin reviewers report smoother, refreshed skin and reduced dryness, with one noting less noticeable fine lines, though one 68-year-old reviewer remained undecided about overall benefit.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin found the cream a good fit and repurchased it.
segments.oily: One reviewer describes their skin as less oily and reports the cream still helps notably with dryness without adding oiliness.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers using the cream for aging or mature skin note firmer, bouncier, or smoother skin and less noticeable fine lines, but improvements are described as mild and one long-time Cetaphil user remained unsure of visible anti-aging effect.
concerns.dehydration: Dryness is the most consistently praised benefit, with many reviewers reporting soft, hydrated, non-dry skin by morning; one reviewer found the cream too heavy and greasy for her dry climate.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, redness-prone, or reactive skin report calming and reduced redness over weeks of use, with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing a compromised or damaged skin barrier report healing, softness, and reduced irritation after switching to this cream.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports lightened dark spots and hyperpigmentation alongside improved texture.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and some report fewer breakouts or eczema flare-ups; one reviewer with unspecified skin type reports the cream caused breakouts due to its heaviness.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers highlight a non-greasy, lightweight feel despite the cream's richness, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Too heavy or greasy for some

extraits.texte: This was way too heavy for me. To the point that it made me break out every time I used it. It's thick and emollient, I didn't notice a scent of any kind, the bottle is perfect for travel, but it was a no for me.

extraits.titre: Holy grail for extra dry skin!!
extraits.texte: This moisturizer is the best cream I have ever used for my face. I have very dry skin and can not say enough good things about this product. It is so rich and moisturizes my skin like nothing else i have ever used. I even use this during the day for my drier days and also add a small amount to my current morning daily moisturizer as my skin loves this!! I will be devistated if they ever discontinue this face cream. If you feel like you have tried everything for your dry skin and struggle to find good products, try this one!!!!

extraits.titre: Amazing night moisturizer for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I am one of the many who has reactions to cosmetic grade retinol products, mostly dermatitis even after one use. I also am very fair and redness shows very easily on my skin, so I don't want harsh active anti-aging products because they cause redness for me. I have used other creams with peptides in them before and tolerated that well, and as a user of Cetaphil products, I was very happy when this came out. I do see many reviews about a smell, but I don't experience this. It doesn't have fragrance, but the smell of the product disappears on me when it is applied. I also have PCOS and can get acne easily, but my skin is very well moisturized and balanced with this cream without breakouts. I also don't wake up with dry feeling skin.

I had a very compromised skin barrier. Nothing was working. I put away all my expensive creams and bought Cetaphil everything. This and the tinted moisturizer are keepers! This is so moisturizing and softening. The redness I've been dealing with for years is almost gone and its only been a month. Yeah, it has a slight foot smell, but its gone in an instant and the results are worth it!

I have sensitive skin, prone to breakouts, and eczema. This is the BEST night cream I've ever used. I wake up looking refreshed, and I've definitely noticed a reduction in acne/eczema breakouts and my skin does feel firmer and bouncier. Only complaint I have is with the smell that others mentioned, but honestly, it goes away quickly and is so minor compared to the benefits. I would not change a thing about this cream and plan to buy it for as long as they keep making it. :)

extraits.texte: I like to stay with items under this name of Cetaphil for my Rosacea. Will be giving it a try soon
